objective: Record the current node-operator operational state, remaining work, and safe suspend/resume procedure in a non-sensitive handoff document.
authorization: The user explicitly requested creation of a handoff document. No cloud, cluster, registry, GitHub setting, or secret mutation is authorized by this documentation task.
constraints: Do not include secret values, Vault tokens, private keys, recovery material, kubeconfigs, or raw logs.
Distinguish last recorded evidence from a fresh live observation.
Document existing checked-in scripts without executing live capacity changes.
successCriteria: The handoff identifies implemented components and their last recorded state.
The handoff gives an ordered, safe resumption and shutdown procedure.
The handoff states the external Engine-JWT custody prerequisite and validator key boundaries.
Structural and script-contract checks pass and an independent clean-room review is recorded.
